deleteAccountPage.title: Delete Account - Gym Trainer (Dupla)
deleteAccountPage.intro: At Gym Trainer (Dupla), we respect your privacy and right to control your data. You can request the permanent deletion of your account and associated data through this page or directly within the mobile application.
deleteAccountPage.option1: Option 1 (In-App): Go to Profile > Settings > Danger Zone > Delete Account. This is immediate.
deleteAccountPage.option2: Option 2 (Web Request): Fill out the form below. We will process your request within 7 days.
deleteAccountPage.dataIntro: The following data will be permanently removed:
deleteAccountPage.retentionText: Some data may be retained for legal or accounting purposes, such as subscription payment records, for a period required by tax laws. Anonymized analytics data may also be kept for service improvement.
deleteAccountPage.pinSentNote: A 6-digit PIN was sent to {{email}}. It expires in 15 minutes.
deleteAccountPage.successMessage: Your account and all associated data have been permanently deleted.
deleteAccountPage.successNote: We're sorry to see you go. You can create a new account anytime.
deleteAccountPage.errorNotFound: No account found with this email.
deleteAccountPage.errorInvalidPin: Invalid or expired PIN. Please request a new one.
deleteAccountPage.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

hero.subtitle: The all-in-one platform connecting personal trainers with their clients. Personalized workouts, real-time session tracking, and nutrition management — all in one place.

features.label: Everything you need
features.title: Built for Results
features.subtitle: Every tool coaches need to grow their business and every feature trainees need to reach their goals.

items.title: Custom Workout Plans
items.desc: Build and assign workout plans with exercises, sets, reps, weight, and RPE targets tailored to each client.

items.title: Live Session Tracking
items.desc: Trainees log sets in real-time during workouts. Every rep, every set, every session — captured instantly.

items.title: Nutrition Tracking
items.desc: Daily calorie and macro logging with food search, goal setting, and weekly nutrition reports.

items.title: Progression Analytics
items.desc: 1RM progression charts and body weight history so coaches and trainees can see real results over time.

items.title: Direct Messaging
items.desc: Real-time 1:1 chat between coaches and trainees. Keep the feedback loop tight and responsive.

items.title: Rest Timer & Cardio
items.desc: Built-in rest timer with sound alerts and a cardio timer with calorie estimates, right inside the session.

how.label: How it works
how.title: One Platform, Two Perspectives
how.subtitle: Dupla gives coaches the tools to manage their business and trainees the experience to train at their best.

coachSteps.title: Add your trainees
coachSteps.desc: Invite clients by email and manage all of them from a single dashboard.

coachSteps.title: Build their programs
coachSteps.desc: Create custom workout plans with exercises tailored to each client's specific goals.

coachSteps.title: Track their progress
coachSteps.desc: See real-time session logs, progression charts, and nutrition data for every trainee.

coachSteps.title: Grow your revenue
coachSteps.desc: Track payments per client and scale with a subscription plan that fits your business.

traineeSteps.title: Connect with your coach
traineeSteps.desc: Your coach adds you to the platform and assigns your personalized training program.

traineeSteps.title: Follow your plan
traineeSteps.desc: View scheduled workouts, start sessions, and log sets with a rest timer built in.

traineeSteps.title: Track your nutrition
traineeSteps.desc: Log daily meals and calories to stay on target with your macro goals.

traineeSteps.title: See your progress
traineeSteps.desc: View 1RM progression and body weight history to stay motivated by real results.
